steps.title: Prepare the space and cut list
steps.notes:
Measure the available space and check clearances before cutting.

steps.title: Sauna: Dry-fit the sauna exterior frames
steps.notes: Dry-fit the listed dimensional wall framing around the reserved clear room and interior-layer allowance. Check square, actual clearances and access; plan temporary support before standing frames. Review the recorded connection schedule; unspecified joints still need fastening details.

steps.title: Sauna: Check the sauna rough opening
steps.notes: Dry-fit the rough-opening members. Check bearing below both ends of the header and how it carries down to the floor. Verify the opening against the door specification and finished floor and walls, and keep access to the framing joints.

steps.title: Sauna: Dry-fit the ceiling framing
steps.notes:
Dry-fit the actual ceiling members and check their contacts, clear room height and temporary support/tool access. Ceiling connections and the complete heated enclosure still require design.
Unbuilt systems: foundation, actual door, insulation/foil/furring/lining, heated benches, heater/electrical and ventilation. The clear interior 72 × 72 × 84 in and bench 60 × 24 × 36 in are reservations, not installed or heat-qualified components.
